name: edge-26.10.2
body:
## What's Changed
* policy-controller: raise gRPC h2 connection window to avoid GOAWAYs by @pujitha24 in https://github.com/linkerd/linkerd2/pull/15668
* proxy: v2.371.0 by @l5d-bot in https://github.com/linkerd/linkerd2/pull/15703
* docs: update contribution guideilnes to include LLM code policy by @mattbailey in https://github.com/linkerd/linkerd2/pull/15709
* fix(tls): ensure client provides tls for tap api server by @raykroeker in https://github.com/linkerd/linkerd2/pull/15697
* chore: fix rate limit policy test by @raykroeker in https://github.com/linkerd/linkerd2/pull/15724
* chore(build): update golang to 1.26.9 by @arichardet in https://github.com/linkerd/linkerd2/pull/15737
* build(deps): bump golang.org/x/tools from 0.50.0 to 0.52.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/linkerd/linkerd2/pull/15721
* chore: update go version. by @toidiu in https://github.com/linkerd/linkerd2/pull/15749
* chore: update Rust dependencies. by @toidiu in https://github.com/linkerd/linkerd2/pull/15748
* build(deps): bump github.com/go-test/deep from 1.1.1 to 1.1.2 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/linkerd/linkerd2/pull/15729
* build(deps): bump fast-uri from 3.1.8 to 3.1.9 in /web/app by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/linkerd/linkerd2/pull/15750
* proxy: v2.372.0 by @l5d-bot in https://github.com/linkerd/linkerd2/pull/15752
* build(deps): bump postcss-selector-parser from 6.0.6 to 6.1.5 in /web/app by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/linkerd/linkerd2/pull/15751
* chore(deps): upgrade proxy-init to v2.4.11 and cni-plugin to v1.7.1 by @anthoturc in https://github.com/linkerd/linkerd2/pull/15754

## New Contributors
* @mattbailey made their first contribution in https://github.com/linkerd/linkerd2/pull/15709
* @toidiu made their first contribution in https://github.com/linkerd/linkerd2/pull/15749

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/linkerd/linkerd2/compare/edge-26.10.1...edge-26.10.2
